subject: Data handling follow-up & training opt-out confirmation — Finova Health
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@finovahealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data handling follow-up & training opt-out confirmation — Finova Health

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the follow-ups we discussed around data handling so your legal/compliance team has what they need to move forward:

- Training-on-customer-data: Finova asked to opt out of any model training on customer data. We can confirm Redwood will honor a training opt-out for all inbound inference data tied to your account (we call this the "no-train" flag). This prevents any usage of your data in model training, continuous improvement pipelines, or public benchmarking sets.

- PII handling and redaction: We described our standard controls — configurable input filtering, token-level masking at the application layer, and optional automatic PII redaction prior to logs. We recommend pushing PII redaction to your client-side pipeline for highest assurance, but Redwood can enable server-side redaction for account-scoped traffic.

- Retention & logging: Default request logs are retained 30 days; we can shorten to 7 or 0 days for logs containing sensitive fields. Audit logs (configuration changes, key rotations) are retained per contract and can be exported to your SIEM.

- Data residency: We support EU-region hosting and can ensure inference processing and short-term logs remain in eu-central-1 (or your chosen EU region).

Next steps (per our call):
1) I will share our DPA and a short SOC2 summary (we'll attach them here).
2) If Finova signs the DPA with the training opt-out clause, we will enable the account-level no-train flag and shorten logs to 7 days by default (or 0 if you prefer).
3) Legal to confirm if they need an amendment or separate addendum for EU residency.

Please let me know if I missed anything or if legal wants different wording for the training opt-out.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

--
Attachment stubs: [Redwood-DPA-2026.pdf (application/pdf)], [SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@finovahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@finovahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Data handling follow-up & training opt-out confirmation — Finova Health

Laura —

Thanks for the summary and for taking notes during the call. A couple clarifications from our side:

1) Confirming Finova wants the training opt-out enabled for all environments (prod and pre-prod) where Finova data is ever processed.
2) Legal would like copies of the DPA and the SOC2 evidence summary you referenced. A brief one-page summary of what is and is not logged would be helpful.
3) Data residency: Finova requires EU-only processing for EU customer data. Can you confirm the eu-central-1 option is available for both inference and short-term logging?

Also, one narrow question from engineering: if data is redacted server-side by Redwood, do you retain an un-redacted copy anywhere in backups or transient caches? We need a clear statement for our security intake form.

If you can send the DPA + SOC2 summary and an explicit sentence about redaction/backups that would help legal move quickly.

Regards,

Sarah Tan
Head of Product, Finova Health
sarah.tan@finovahealth.com

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@finovahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data handling follow-up & training opt-out confirmation — Finova Health

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. Confirmations below and next steps:

1) Training opt-out scope: once Finova signs the DPA (attached), Redwood will set an account-level no-train flag that applies to all environments (prod, staging, pre-prod) for that account id. No customer inference data will be used in any training or improvement pipelines thereafter.

2) DPA & SOC2: attaching the DPA and our SOC2 summary as PDFs (short summary, not the full report). If legal needs a bridge letter from our auditor we can escalate.

3) EU residency: yes — we offer eu processing and storage in eu-central-1. When you select EU residency in the onboarding form we pin the account to the EU region and configure network egress controls. Short-term request logs can be restricted to EU only.

4) Redaction and backups: server-side redaction will remove or mask identified PII fields from logs before they are written to long-term storage. Transient caches (e.g., in-memory KV cache for sequence contexts) are not persisted to long-term backups. Backups and long-term archives do not contain un-redacted inference payloads. We will include the following sentence in the DPA if you prefer explicit language: "Redwood will not retain un-redacted copies of customer-provided inference inputs or outputs in backups or long-term archives; all persistent storage of customer inference data will be subject to configured redaction and retention policies."

Next steps:
- Attached: Redwood-DPA-2026.pdf, SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf
- Docusign link for the DPA: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

If these look good, legal can sign the DPA and we will enable the no-train flag and set log retention to 7 days by default (we can set 0 days on a per-route basis if you want maximal minimization).

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Security | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stubs: [Redwood-DPA-2026.pdf (application/pdf)], [SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

---

From: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@finovahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@finovahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data handling follow-up & training opt-out confirmation — Finova Health

Rachel —

This is perfect and covers what legal asked for. Two small follow-ups before we route to countersignature: 

1) Can you insert that explicit redaction/backups sentence into the DPA text (if you can email the amended page we can speed review).
2) For automated server-side redaction: does Redwood log an event that redaction occurred (yes/no) and what does that event contain? We prefer a boolean-level event (redaction=true) without carrying redacted content.

If you can send a one-paragraph amendment for #1 and a one-sentence confirmation for #2 I will ask legal to review and sign.

Thanks — we aim to have this back to you by Thursday.

Best,

Sarah
